name: bite_down_the_creature_is_the_damage_source
notes: Printed: 'Target creature you control deals damage equal to its power to target creature or planeswalker you don't control.' The damage is dealt by the creature, not by the spell: seat 0's 2/2 Venom Leech (deathtouch, lifelink) bites seat 1's 6/6 Colossus. It deals 2 damage with deathtouch, so the Colossus dies, and seat 0 gains 2 life from the lifelink (22). The Leech takes no damage back.
